checks: total_amount > 0 AND total_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 4950 AND item_count BETWEEN 1 AND 50
source IN ('DIRECT','CART') AND currency = 'CNY' AND CHAR_LENGTH(request_key) = 36 AND CHAR_LENGTH(request_hash) = 64 AND JSON_TYPE(delivery_info_json) = 'OBJECT'

expire_time > create_time AND (paid_time IS NULL OR (paid_time >= create_time AND paid_time < expire_time)) AND (cancelled_time IS NULL OR cancelled_time >= create_time) AND (completed_time IS NULL OR completed_time >= paid_time)

(status = '1' AND paid_time IS NULL AND cancelled_time IS NULL AND completed_time IS NULL) OR (status = '2' AND paid_time IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_time IS NULL AND completed_time IS NULL) OR (status = '3' AND paid_time IS NULL AND cancelled_time IS NOT NULL AND completed_time IS NULL AND cancel_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status = '4' AND paid_time IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_time IS NULL AND completed_time IS NOT NULL)
tables.business: 状态、成功支付/交付记录、明细总额和库存的跨表一致性必须由事务服务保证，CHECK 只验证当前行。先查幂等记录再查报价，旧请求在 Redis 报价过期后仍能返回原单。

checks: before_stock BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000 AND after_stock BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000 AND change_qty BETWEEN -1000000000 AND 1000000000 AND after_stock = before_stock + change_qty

(biz_type = 'INITIAL' AND before_stock = 0 AND change_qty >= 0 AND order_id IS NULL) OR (biz_type = 'ORDER_RESERVE' AND change_qty < 0 AND order_id IS NOT NULL) OR (biz_type = 'ORDER_RELEASE' AND change_qty > 0 AND order_id IS NOT NULL) OR (biz_type = 'ADMIN_ADJUST' AND change_qty <> 0 AND order_id IS NULL AND request_hash IS NOT NULL)
(operator_type = 'SYSTEM' AND operator_id IS NULL) OR (operator_type IN ('ADMIN','MEMBER') AND operator_id IS NOT NULL AND operator_id > 0)
